claim: does design/divider/divider_intN.sch (the standalone programmable integer-N feedback divider, issue #27, retimed to a dual-modulus /2-/3 prescaler front-end by issue #114) divide a fixed 250 MHz ideal CLK by N=20 (NSEL[5:0]=010011, i.e. N-1=19 in plain binary per design/divider/DESIGN.md) cleanly. N=20 is the modulus of the proposed 25 MHz x 20 = 500 MHz interface (spec/decision-records/DR-011-500mhz-feasibility-plan.md Step 2, proposed) and sits on the even decode path. This bench is prepared but UNEXECUTED (issue #352): it is a design-input measurement bench, not a spec/target-spec.md ratification; row 4 stays DRAFT, and per CLAUDE.md ratification is a separate decision-record act.
spec_rows_note: spec/target-spec.md row 4 (multiplication ratio, DRAFT N = 4-64) at N=20, the ratio of the proposed 500 MHz interface. Evidence toward the row once executed, not a verdict on it; no record exists yet.
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/divider/divider_intN.sch driven open-loop (no VCO, PFD/charge pump or loop filter in the path), exactly as its N=5 sibling sim/divider-n5/testbench/tb.json -- CLK is an ideal rail-to-rail pulse source (12.5 ps edges, 4 ns period = 250 MHz, 50% duty) and NSEL[5:0]=010011 (N-1 = 19, so N=20; derived from design/divider/DESIGN.md's NSEL = N-1 encoding, not copied from a sibling) is strapped statically via lab_pin ties to VDD/GND. RESETB is released by a pwl at 5-6 ns. `measure.lock`'s target_hz (12500000 Hz = f_CLK/N = 250 MHz/20) with a 2% tolerance and a 5-output-period window/hold applies the same sliding-window lock criterion the N=5 bench uses. The frequency-sweep half of the 500 MHz question (a CLK probe at 500 MHz, whose expected output is 25 MHz / 40 ns) is NOT run from this fixed-frequency manifest: it is the mandatory probe of sim/divider-fmax/testbench/fmax-stage-a-500mhz.json. This manifest declares the same full 5-corner x 3-temp x 3-supply default grid every other sim/ manifest declares. No simulation has been run for this manifest under issue #352; the schematic netlist/lock check is outstanding for the execution gate.
analysis: transient, standalone divider (`tran 20p 1000n`, injected by sim/harness/measure.py from this manifest's own measure block). The 1000 ns window covers roughly 12.4 output periods at the target frequency (12.5 MHz, 80 ns/period) after RESETB releases at 6 ns -- more than the 11 edges (window_cycles + 1 + min_hold_cycles) the lock criterion needs.
